**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the civic or technical challenge is (e.g., "Citizens need offline GPS caching when network connectivity drops in certain wards...").

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Target Component:**
- [ ] Backend (Flask / SQLAlchemy)
- [ ] Frontend (HTML5 / Bootstrap 5 / Accessibility)
- [ ] Geospatial Mapping (Leaflet.js / OpenStreetMap)
- [ ] Analytics (Chart.js / Reporting API)
- [ ] Documentation / University Syllabus Alignment

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, wireframes, or references to other open-source civic tools here.
